name: Object wording
description: What the renderer is told about each kind of thing. These are the defaults; a style file may override door, window, wall and ground for itself. Every phrase is joined into a sentence that already ends with the rectangle it applies to, so write them as descriptions of a thing, not as commands.

structure.door: A closed door filling this opening in the wall, seen from directly overhead so only the flat top face of the door leaf is visible: a plain rectangular timber panel with dark iron bands across it, lying flush inside the wall opening and squared up with the wall, exactly as wide as the wall is thick. It is drawn flat, straight on and level with everything around it, with no perspective, no tilt, no arch or vault above it, no door frame standing proud, no steps and no visible handle
structure.window: a window set into the wall: a stone or timber frame holding small panes of glass, its sill and lintel clearly drawn
structure.wall: solid stone wall with visible courses
structure.ship: One large wooden sailing ship floating on the water, viewed from directly above so only its weather deck is visible: a pointed bow at the right, a raised quarterdeck at the left, a continuous timber bulwark rail running round the hull, weathered oak deck planking running fore and aft, a square cargo hatch amidships, the round base of a single mast with coiled rigging, and mooring ropes running to the dock. No sails and no lower decks.

phrasing.exact: It sits exactly inside this rectangle and nowhere else
phrasing.elaboration_exact: Render this exactly as described and add nothing to it
phrasing.elaboration_some: Render this as described, filling in fitting detail
phrasing.elaboration_free: Take this as a starting point and elaborate it richly with fitting detail

terrain.pit: an open pit dropping into darkness

effects.fire: leaping orange flames with a bright hot core, throwing firelight across the surrounding ground
effects.embers: a bed of glowing orange embers pulsing with heat, drifting sparks rising from it
effects.smoke: thick grey smoke curling upward, the ground dimly visible through it
effects.fog: a low bank of pale drifting fog, thinning at its edges, the ground still readable beneath it
effects.mist: thin silver mist clinging low to the ground
effects.fireflies: a scatter of tiny warm yellow-green points of light hanging in the air
effects.magic_glow: a soft violet arcane glow washing over the ground, brightest at its centre
effects.holy_light: a shaft of pale golden light falling from above onto the ground
effects.poison_gas: a sickly yellow-green vapour lying heavy and low
effects.blood: dark red blood pooled and smeared across the ground
effects.ice: a sheet of pale blue ice with white frost feathering out from its edge
effects.webs: sheets of dusty grey spider web strung across the space
effects.sparks: bright white sparks arcing and scattering
effects.ash: grey ash settled in drifts, more of it still falling
effects.steam: white steam venting upward in soft billows
effects.shadow: an unnatural pool of deep shadow that swallows the light

props.sarcophagus: a heavy stone sarcophagus with a chipped lid
props.desk: a writing desk covered in papers
props.bed: a straw mattress on a timber frame

props.hearth: a stone hearth with burning logs
